text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after Daiwa Scarlet's debut…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My, would you look at that! Another special on Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sigh… It's just Scarlet and Vodka, everywhere I look…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How about this for a scoop? The talented Magical Girl Sweepy is killing it in the big leagues!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, now. Don't go picking fights, or I'll have to sound the gong!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …The gong?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, take a look at this article—"The Future Queens of Racing!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: First place is Vodka, and then next is… you—Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Which makes me the runner-up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You look disappointed. I thought that would be quite an honor!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah… Sorry! I shouldn't be talking like that in front of you…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't worry about it. A refined princess is patient in all things! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But you should take more pride in yourself! Many people would give a lot for what you have!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Great, now I feel like garbage. And it's all because of her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?! D-don't get the wrong idea! I would never say something so―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just you. Geez, don't scare me like that…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? Vodka. Everyone just keeps going on and on about how great she is.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She's so annoying! And she's wrecking all my hard work!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, why?! She stole my number one spot!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Everyone sings your praises when you're number one! Like, "Wow, look at her! She's so cool!" You know!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But when you get second place, it's all, "Well, you tried your best. You'll get it next time."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't want pity. I want admiration.
choice_data_list: You're already number one in my book.
You're already number one in my book.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So what?! That's not what I'm looking to hear, dummy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief… What I'm trying to say is that I need you to be giving your all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Once I get first place in the Classics, everyone will start looking at me differently.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So I can't slack off while I'm still a junior.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll train, and train, and train, until I'm strong enough to snatch number one. And then…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll blow them all away with beauty and grace in my first Classic race!
